summary: ZTO Express (Cayman) Inc., a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K with Hong Kong next-day disclosure returns covering share buybacks on nine dates from August 12–24, 2026. The repurchases totaled 1,821,037 American depositary shares at prices ranging from $21.22 to $23.00 per ADS. These open-market purchases are part of an ongoing capital-return program, reducing issued shares. The filing is routine disclosure of buyback activity, not a tender or strategic event. Watch for continuation of buybacks and impacts on share count and EPS.
